title: Path length and logit token prediction

cues.en: Let's continue with our investigations of embeddings vectors with another analysis that is different
cues.zh: 繼續研究嵌入向量，這次使用另一項分析，它與查看向量之間角度差

cues.en: from, but related to looking at the angle of differences between vectors.
cues.zh: 不同，但彼此相關。

cues.en: What I will show you in this video is called path length, and it quantifies the distance that the embeddings
cues.zh: 這支影片要展示的是路徑長度，量化嵌入

cues.en: vector travels as it passes from one layer to the next.
cues.zh: 向量從一層到下一層，移動了多少距離。

cues.en: When I switch to code, you will see that we get some really stunning and thought provoking beautiful findings.
cues.zh: 切換到程式碼後，會看到一些非常驚人、引人思考又漂亮的發現。

cues.en: But unfortunately when I tried to replicate it, the pattern will turn out to be not universal, or at least more nuanced than a simplistic interpretation.
cues.zh: 但很遺憾，嘗試重現時，會發現模式並不普遍，或者至少比簡單解讀更加細膩。

cues.en: I will start by defining the concept of path length in linear algebra, and then I will discuss it in the context of embeddings vectors in language models.
cues.zh: 先定義線性代數中路徑長度的概念，再放到語言模型嵌入向量的脈絡討論。

cues.en: So imagine these are two vectors on this graph.
cues.zh: 假設圖上有這兩個向量。

cues.en: Now you can think of these as lines coming from the origin.
cues.zh: 可以把它們想成從原點出發的線，

cues.en: But you can also think of these as being two coordinates at these two arrowheads.
cues.zh: 也能想成位於兩個箭頭尖端的兩個座標。

cues.en: So if we want to know what is the distance, what is the length of the path to get from one coordinate
cues.zh: 如果想知道，從一個座標到另一個，距離、路徑長度

cues.en: to the next, you can use Euclidean geometry to calculate that distance.
cues.zh: 是多少，可以用歐幾里得幾何計算。

cues.en: And when we think of these vectors in the linear algebra sense, then we can think about the path length
cues.zh: 從線性代數角度思考向量時，可以先想像

cues.en: from one vector to another by first thinking about the line or the vector that connects the head of
cues.zh: 從一個向量到另一個的路徑長度，也就是連接

cues.en: one vector to the head of the other vector, and then to measure the length of that line.
cues.zh: 兩個向量尖端的線或向量，再測量那條線的長度。

cues.en: This is the path length here.
cues.zh: 這裡就是路徑長度。

cues.en: You can take the difference between the two vectors.
cues.zh: 可以取兩個向量的差，

cues.en: So literally one vector minus the other.
cues.zh: 真的就是一個向量減另一個，

cues.en: And then you calculate the norm of that vector.
cues.zh: 再計算該向量的範數。

cues.en: Remember that the norm of a vector is the square root of the sum of the squared elements.
cues.zh: 記住，向量範數是元素平方和的平方根。

cues.en: So that's equivalent to Euclidean distance between these two arrowheads here.
cues.zh: 這等同於兩個箭頭尖端之間的歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So this diagram was a bit generic just to illustrate the concept in math in linear algebra.
cues.zh: 這張圖比較一般化，只是示範數學、線性代數中的概念。

cues.en: Of course we cannot really draw these token embeddings vectors because they're just too high dimensional.
cues.zh: 當然，這些 token 嵌入向量維度太高，無法真的畫出來。

cues.en: But imagine that this graph shows the embeddings vectors for one specific token as it traverses through the transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 但想像這張圖，顯示某個特定 token 通過 Transformer 區塊時的嵌入向量。

cues.en: So T1 would be the vector for a given token when it comes out of the first transformer block.
cues.zh: T1 是某個 token 從第一個 Transformer 區塊出來時的向量，

cues.en: And then T2 is the output of the second transformer block, and so on.
cues.zh: T2 則是第二個區塊的輸出，依此類推。

cues.en: And here I'm depicting five transformer blocks for the same token.
cues.zh: 這裡畫出同一個 token 的五個 Transformer 區塊。

cues.en: Of course, you know that the goal of a transformer block is to take a token embeddings vector, add
cues.zh: 你當然知道，Transformer 區塊的目標，是取一個 token 嵌入向量，

cues.en: a little bit of a rotation or a stretching or contraction according to the context that the token is presented in, and then pass it along to the next transformer block.
cues.zh: 根據 token 所處上下文，加入一點旋轉、伸長或收縮，再傳給下一個 Transformer 區塊。

cues.en: So the idea is that when a transformer block has a really big impact on a token, then the path length
cues.zh: 概念是，如果某個 Transformer 區塊對 token 影響很大，

cues.en: from the output of one transformer block to the next should be really large.
cues.zh: 從前一個區塊輸出到下一個的路徑長度，就應該很大。

cues.en: In contrast, if a transformer block doesn't really modify a token embedding vector that much, maybe it adds a tiny little adjustment.
cues.zh: 相對地，如果某個區塊沒有大幅修改 token 嵌入，也許只加一點微小調整，

cues.en: Then we would expect the path length across the two transformer blocks to be quite small.
cues.zh: 就預期兩個 Transformer 區塊之間的路徑長度很小。

cues.en: And that's really the idea of the analysis that I will show you in this video.
cues.zh: 這就是這支影片要展示的分析概念。

cues.en: So we're really just measuring the magnitude of the differences between the token embeddings vectors across different transformer blocks.
cues.zh: 其實只是在測量，不同 Transformer 區塊之間，token 嵌入向量差異的大小。

cues.en: So here is what I'm going to show you in the Python demo.
cues.zh: 以下是 Python 示範的內容。

cues.en: I'll start by importing several different versions of GPT two.
cues.zh: 先匯入幾個不同版本的 GPT2。

cues.en: Now the reason for loading in several models here is that we want to see if the results that we get from the small version are reproduced in these larger versions.
cues.zh: 載入幾個模型的原因，是想看看小型版本的結果，能否在較大型版本重現。

cues.en: Next, I will tokenize a bit of text that I copied from the Wikipedia page on Nietzsche.
cues.zh: 接著，將從維基百科尼采頁面複製的一段文字 token 化。

cues.en: I'm sure you've heard of this guy.
cues.zh: 相信你聽過這個人。

cues.en: He is one of the most important and influential philosophers of the past few centuries.
cues.zh: 他是過去幾個世紀，最重要、最具影響力的哲學家之一。

cues.en: He also suffered from several physical and mental problems, but he definitely had a lot of style when
cues.zh: 他也有幾項身體與心理問題，但在留鬍子，以及

cues.en: it came to growing mustaches and having those mustaches match his necktie.
cues.zh: 讓鬍子與領帶搭配這方面，絕對很有風格。

cues.en: So at least he had that going for him.
cues.zh: 至少這點是他的長處。

cues.en: Uh, sadly, Nietzsche was mostly ostracized and ignored by his colleagues during his lifetime, and
cues.zh: 可惜，尼采在世時，多半遭同僚排斥與忽略，

cues.en: his writings and his intellectual prowess only became influential after he died.
cues.zh: 他的著作與才智，直到死後才開始有影響力。

cues.en: Anyway, I am going to push through some of this text through the model, get the hidden state activations
cues.zh: 總之，將部分文字送進模型，取得所有 Transformer 層的隱藏狀態

cues.en: for all of the transformer layers, and then calculate the path length changes from one layer to the
cues.zh: 活化，再計算一層到下一層的路徑長度變化，

cues.en: next, and then also calculate the cumulative path length that is just the cumulative sum over all of the individual path lengths.
cues.zh: 也計算累積路徑長度，就是將個別路徑長度全部累加。

cues.en: And that's what you see on the left panel of this figure here.
cues.zh: 這就是這張圖左邊面板看到的內容。

cues.en: So the x axis is the transformer block.
cues.zh: x 軸是 Transformer 區塊，

cues.en: The y axis is the total path length.
cues.zh: y 軸是總路徑長度，

cues.en: So the cumulative path length and each dotted line in here is for a different token in the sequence.
cues.zh: 也就是累積路徑長度，每一條虛點線，對應序列中的不同 token。

cues.en: So in this paragraph, of course, these values keep increasing because lengths are non-negative quantities, and we're just summing up more of them as we go through the model.
cues.zh: 也就是這段文字中的 token。這些值當然持續增加，因為長度非負，而隨模型往後，只是不斷將更多長度相加。

cues.en: And this scatter plot over here shows a really remarkable correlation.
cues.zh: 這邊的散佈圖，顯示一個很驚人的相關。

cues.en: So we have path length on the y axis.
cues.zh: y 軸是路徑長度，

cues.en: And this is actually not the cumulative path length.
cues.zh: 但其實不是累積路徑長度，

cues.en: It's just the change from the penultimate transformer block to the final transformer block.
cues.zh: 只是倒數第二個，到最後一個 Transformer 區塊的變化，

cues.en: So 11 to 12.
cues.zh: 也就是 11 到 12。

cues.en: And then on the x axis is the final logit at the output of the model for the token that comes next.
cues.zh: x 軸則是模型輸出端，針對真正下一個 token 的最終 logit，

cues.en: So next token prediction.
cues.zh: 也就是下一個 token 預測。

cues.en: So basically larger numbers here means that the model is giving a stronger activation to the true next token the real token that came next.
cues.zh: 基本上，這裡數字越大，表示模型對真正下一個 token，也就是實際接著出現的 token，給予更強活化。

cues.en: Now this is a fantastic finding because it means that the shorter the path length, which means the
cues.zh: 這是個很棒的發現，因為表示路徑越短，也就是

cues.en: closer the embeddings vectors are to each other from layer 11 to 12, the more likely the model is to make an accurate prediction of the subsequent token.
cues.zh: 第 11 到第 12 層的嵌入向量越接近，模型越有可能準確預測後續 token。

cues.en: Now, all of these data here is just for the small version of GPT two.
cues.zh: 不過，這裡全部資料，只來自 GPT2 的小型版本。

cues.zh: 但先說結論，這個漂亮模式有些重現，但並不完全。

cues.zh: 這裡非常相似。

cues.zh: 取得目前的活化向量，

cues.zh: 也就是 hidden states 中，這個特定層、第一個序列、這個特定 token，

cues.zh: 以及所有嵌入維度。

cues.en: So this gives me one vector for the current processing of the of one token.
